evidence.quote: 7 Semester : Standard period of study: 3.5 years
International students who are not citizens of an EU/EEA member state and do not have a German university entrance qualification

notes: The programme's teaching language is mixed: basic studies (first year) in English, main studies in German. The proof of German language skills at B2 (DSH-1, TestDAF, telc Deutsch B2, Goethe B2-Certificate) is required for progression to the main studies, not for admission, so it is not included as an admission rule. The documents list comes from the general Bachelor application checklist, not from a programme-specific list; the programme has open admission. Tuition: EUR 1,500 per semester (EUR 3,000/year) applies to international students from non-EU/EEA countries without a German university entrance qualification.
